must_cover: What the card is: the recipe 'Hähnchen-Gemüse-Blech mit Zitronenreis' (main course, one tray) for 4 portions; active time 25 minutes, total time 50 minutes, difficulty easy, oven 220 degrees C top and bottom heat (200 degrees C fan), about 620 kcal per portion. (The kind 'manual' is the closest value in the fixed kind list for step-by-step instructions.)

The ingredients in three groups: for the tray 600 g chicken breast fillet, 400 g sweet potatoes, 2 red peppers (about 300 g), 1 courgette (about 250 g), 1 red onion, 3 tbsp olive oil, 2 tsp sweet paprika, 1 tsp dried thyme, 1.5 tsp salt, 0.5 tsp pepper; for the lemon rice 250 g basmati rice, 500 ml water, 0.5 tsp salt, 1 organic lemon (zest and juice); for the dip 200 g natural yoghurt, 1 garlic clove, 1 tbsp lemon juice, 1 bunch parsley, 1 pinch of salt

The eight steps with their times: 1 preheat (minute 0); 2 cut (minute 0 to 10: sweet potatoes in 2 cm cubes, peppers and courgette in 3 cm pieces, chicken in 3 cm cubes); 3 pre-bake the sweet potatoes with 1 tbsp oil and 0.5 tsp salt for 10 minutes at 220 degrees C (minute 10 to 20); 4 season the rest meanwhile; 5 everything on the tray for another 25 minutes (minute 20 to 45), turn after 12 minutes, chicken done at a core temperature of at least 74 degrees C; 6 rice from minute 28: 12 minutes simmering covered on the lowest heat, then 5 minutes standing off the heat; 7 yoghurt dip (minute 30 to 35); 8 serve (minute 45 to 50)

The parallel timeline (Figure 1 'Abbildung 1', page 2): five rows (cutting and seasoning, oven, rice, yoghurt dip, serving) on a minute axis 0 to 50; the oven preheats from minute 0 to 10, bakes the sweet potatoes from 10 to 20 and the whole tray from 20 to 45; the rice (28 to 45) and the dip (30 to 35) run while the tray is in the oven; a dashed line marks turning the tray at minute 32
How the timing adds up: the tray needs no supervision from minute 20, rice starts at minute 28 so it finishes together with the tray at minute 45, serving takes 5 minutes, total 50 minutes
The nutrition table per portion (about): 620 kcal (31 % of a 2,000 kcal daily need), protein 44 g (88 %), carbohydrates 78 g (30 %), fat 14 g (20 %); these are guide values, not dietary advice

The tips: do not overload the tray (one layer, two trays if in doubt), cut pieces to similar sizes with sweet potatoes smaller, check the 74 degrees C core temperature and clear juices, vegetarian variant with 400 g chickpeas and 200 g halloumi (chickpeas after minute 20), leftovers keep up to 2 days in the fridge and rice should be reheated only once and thoroughly
units: degrees C (oven, top and bottom heat)
minutes (sweet potatoes alone in the oven)
minute at which the rice starts
minute at which the tray is turned
figures: Figure 1 'Abbildung 1' (page 2): a tikz timeline (Gantt-style) of five rows on a 0 to 50 minute axis: Schneiden und würzen (0 to 20, two bars Schneiden and Würzen), Backofen (Vorheizen 0 to 10, Süßkartoffeln 10 to 20, ganzes Blech 20 to 45), Reis (quellen 28 to 40, ziehen 40 to 45), Joghurt-Dip (rühren 30 to 35), Anrichten (Servieren 45 to 50), and a dashed vertical line at minute 32 'Blech wenden'. A tour should point at the oven row and the rice and dip bars that overlap it

Page 1: ingredient lists in three groups (left column) beside the numbered steps (right column); page 2: nutrition table (no caption) and the Tipps box
pitfalls: Do not drop the temperatures and times: 220 degrees C top and bottom heat (200 degrees C fan), 10 + 25 minutes in the oven, 12 + 5 minutes for the rice, core temperature of at least 74 degrees C for the chicken
Do not read the page as one column: the ingredient groups on the left and the steps on the right sit side by side; list ingredients and steps separately and in the printed order
Do not start the rice or the dip at the wrong time; the rice goes on at minute 28 and the dip is made at minute 30, while the tray bakes
Do not scale quantities for other portion counts without saying that the card is for 4 portions, and do not invent amounts (for example for seasoning or oil that are not listed)
Do not give dietary, allergy or medical advice from the nutrition table; the card says the values are guide values, and it does not mention allergens (the recipe contains milk products and chicken)
Do not mix up the vegetarian variant with the main recipe; it replaces the chicken with 400 g chickpeas and 200 g halloumi
